title: Tournaments
subtitle: Run a Swiss-round tournament from your phone, or join one with its code.
joinHint: Enter the 6-character code given by the organizer, or scan their QR code with your camera.
name: Tournament name
boutiqueHint: Store: 3 Swiss rounds, whatever the number of players.
competitiveHint: Competitive: number of rounds based on attendance, then an optional top cut.
offline: Offline: will retry as soon as the network is back.
tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Try again in a minute.
organizersOnly: This page is reserved for the tournament organizers.
unsynced: {n, plural, one {# action not synced} other {# actions not synced}}
codeHint: Players scan this QR code with their camera or enter the code in the app.
personalQrHint: {name} scans this QR code to get their profile on their phone. Valid for 15 minutes, single use.
mergeHint: Pick {name}'s other profile: its history will be attached to {name}.
noRound: No round yet. Add the players, then pair round 1.
swapIntro: Tap a player then another one to swap them.
swapHint: Tap a second player to swap them, or give them the bye.
remainingMatches: {n, plural, one {# match without a confirmed result} other {# matches without a confirmed result}}
noShowConfirm: Mark {name} as absent? Their opponent wins the match.
draftOutdated: Players changed since pairing: pair again before starting.
correctionWarning: A result was corrected after the next round was paired: pairings already published were not redone.
confirmPending: {n} registration(s) awaiting approval. Ignore them and start?
confirmDecline: Does {name} give up the top cut? The next player in the standings takes the spot.
drawLine: {picked} qualified among {tied} players in a perfect tie
oneDeviceMode: Score confirmed on the reporter's phone
oneDeviceOrganizer: To be approved by the organizer
latePolicy: Rounds missed by a late player
inviteHint: Send this link: it works once, for 7 days, with an account.
confirmDelete: Delete this tournament and all its results for good?
inviteAcceptHint: You are invited to co-organize this tournament: you will manage players, rounds and results.
guestHint: No account needed: this phone will stay linked to your nickname.
registrationClosedHint: Registration is closed. Please ask the organizer.
waitingApproval: Registration sent: the organizer must accept it.
waitingStart: You are registered. Waiting for the first round.
notInRound: You are not paired this round.
roundNotStarted: The round has not started yet.
yourBye: Bye this round: you win the match.
contestedHint: Disputed score: the organizer will decide.
waitingOrganizer: Confirmed in person, waiting for the organizer.
confirmOnSiteHint: {name} does not have the app: have them confirm the score on your phone.
confirmDropMe: Leave the tournament? You will no longer be paired.
claimHint: The organizer showed you your personal QR: this phone will be linked to your player profile.
